description: List precisely filtered, approved catalog products for a public supplier storefront.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous product list.

gtin.description: Exact GTIN, UPC or EAN filter within the selected supplier storefront.

limit.description: Number of products to return; server clamps this to 100.

maxLeadTimeDays.description: Maximum stated lead time in calendar days.

maxMoq.description: Maximum acceptable order quantity in whole units.

maxPrice.description: Maximum unit price in the listing currency.

minInventory.description: Minimum supplier-confirmed sellable inventory in whole units.

minMoq.description: Minimum acceptable order quantity in whole units.

minPrice.description: Minimum unit price in the listing currency.

q.description: Free-text filter across the selected supplier product fields.

sku.description: Exact SKU filter within the selected supplier storefront.

supplierId.description: Stable supplier ID returned by search_suppliers; this scopes every result to one storefront.

verifiedOnly.description: When true, return only products with the supplier verification signal.

name: list_supplier_products

outputSchema.description: Paginated products scoped to one supplier, or null when the supplier is not found.
